candidate.title: Public booking endpoint leaks raw Prisma error messages and misclassifies DB failures as HTTP 400 in loadUsers()
reports: packages/features/bookings/lib/handlenewbooking.ts:759 — new loadusers catch re-throws prisma error messages verbatim as a 400 to unauthenticated bookers, leaking model/field and query details

handlenewbooking.ts:~750-763 — loadusers catch masks root causes: non-httperror/non-prisma errors become generic unlogged 500s, prisma errors are rethrown as 400s with raw driver messages, and the new early-throw on empty dynamicuserlist changes behavior so empty dynamic lists now surface as 500s

the loadusers rewrite in handlenewbooking.ts:724-762 swallows errors: the catch block converts every unexpected error into a generic 500 'unable to load users' (masking root causes) while leaking raw prisma error messages to the client as 400, and the dynamicuserlist guard error also becomes a 500 instead of the presumably-intended 400.

loadusers (handlenewbooking.ts:~724-762) swallows the specific failure reasons it just introduced: the new throw new error("dynamicuserlist is not properly defined or empty.") and throw new error("eventtype.hosts is not properly defined.") are thrown inside the try, so the catch converts them into a generic 500 'unable to load users' — the descriptive messages never reach the client and nothing is logged; additionally an empty dynamicuserlist, which previously flowed into normal no-users handling, is now a hard 500, and prisma known-errors are rethrown as 400s with raw prisma messages
